source._comment: STAGED SKELETON -- checked 2026-10-14, no feed found. Missouri's first-ever no-excuse in-person early-voting window for the general runs 2026-10-20 through 2026-11-02 (general_start corrected above from the generic 10-15 placeholder) -- it has NOT started yet as of this check. sos.mo.gov/elections/results links only to final, certified, post-election PDF turnout reports (one per past election, nothing live/current). The 'Show MO Votes' tool (sos.mo.gov/elections/showmovotes) is an Angular SPA shell with no turnout content or data-api reference in its static HTML -- it appears to only populate on/after election night, not during early voting. enr.sos.mo.gov (Election Night Reporting) returns HTTP 403 (Cloudflare-style WAF block) to a non-browser fetch, same for every guessed API path under it. Missouri elections are run by 116 independent local election authorities with no evidence of a centralized statewide daily early-voting-by-county report (unlike GA's Qlik hub or WI's static CSV) -- coverage so far is county clerks quoting their own numbers to local reporters, not a state feed. Re-check once the window opens (10-20) and again close to election day: if ENR/Show MO Votes turns out to go live with per-county absentee/early numbers during the window (not just election night), it may be fetchable the way mt_update.py bootstraps its Tableau session, but that couldn't be confirmed while it's dormant. Until then this reads 0.
